name: royalty-statement
title: Royalty and marketing levy statement
for_each: select s.id, s.ref || ' ' || s.name as name from sites s where s.status = 'trading' order by s.ref

sections.title: The site
sections.sql: select s.ref, s.name as site, f.name as franchisee, f.entity, a.ref as agreement, a.royalty_pct || '%' as royalty_rate, a.marketing_pct || '%' as marketing_levy, s.currency from sites s left join franchisees f on f.id = s.franchisee_id left join agreements a on a.site_id = s.id and a.status = 'active' where s.id = $1

sections.title: The last six months
sections.sql: select month, coalesce(to_char(gross_sales_cents / 100.0, 'FM999,999,990.00'), 'not reported') as gross_sales, to_char(royalty_cents / 100.0, 'FM999,990.00') as royalty, to_char(marketing_cents / 100.0, 'FM999,990.00') as levy, to_char(paid_cents / 100.0, 'FM999,990.00') as paid, to_char(balance_cents / 100.0, 'FM999,990.00') as balance, to_char(due_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as due, state from v_royalties where site_id = $1 order by period desc limit 6

sections.title: Balance owing
sections.sql: select currency, to_char(coalesce(sum(balance_cents), 0) / 100.0, 'FM999,999,990.00') as total_balance, count(*) filter (where state like 'OVERDUE%') as months_overdue, count(*) filter (where state = 'NOT REPORTED') as reports_missing from v_royalties where site_id = $1 group by currency

name: visit-report
title: Field visit report
for_each: select a.id, a.ref || ' ' || s.name as name from audits a join sites s on s.id = a.site_id where a.status = 'completed' and a.visited_on >= current_date - 90 order by a.ref

sections.title: The visit
sections.sql: select a.ref, s.name as site, f.name as franchisee, a.kind, to_char(a.visited_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as visited, st.name as by, a.score, a.summary from audits a join sites s on s.id = a.site_id left join franchisees f on f.id = s.franchisee_id left join staff st on st.id = a.staff_id where a.id = $1

sections.title: Findings and when each is due
sections.sql: select ref, severity, item, to_char(due_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as due, coalesce(to_char(closed_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'open') as closed, evidence from findings where audit_id = $1 order by array_position(array['critical','major','minor'], severity), ref

name: franchisee-file
title: Franchisee file
for_each: select id, ref || ' ' || name as name from franchisees where status = 'active' order by ref

sections.title: The franchisee
sections.sql: select ref, name, entity, business_number, email, phone, insurer, insurance_policy, to_char(insurance_expires_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as insurance_expires from franchisees where id = $1

sections.title: Sites and agreements
sections.sql: select a.site_ref as site, a.site as name, a.ref as agreement, a.kind, a.status, to_char(a.disclosure_given_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as disclosure_given, to_char(a.signed_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as signed, a.days_considered, to_char(a.term_end, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as term_ends, to_char(a.notice_due_by, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as notice_due_by from v_agreements a where a.franchisee_id = $1 order by a.term_start desc nulls last

sections.title: Certificates at their sites
sections.sql: select s.name as site, c.holder, c.kind, to_char(c.expires_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as expires from certificates c join sites s on s.id = c.site_id where s.franchisee_id = $1 order by c.expires_on

sections.title: Breach notices
sections.sql: select b.ref, to_char(b.issued_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as issued, b.breach, b.remedy, to_char(b.remedy_by, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as remedy_by, b.status from breach_notices b join agreements a on a.id = b.agreement_id where a.franchisee_id = $1 order by b.issued_on desc

name: fund-statement
title: Marketing fund statement (draft for the accountant)
for_each: select id, 'Year to ' || to_char(fy_end, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as name from franchisor_years where fy_end < current_date order by fy_end desc

sections.title: The year
sections.sql: select to_char(v.fy_end, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as year_to, to_char(v.levied_cents / 100.0, 'FM999,999,990.00') as levied, to_char(v.collected_cents / 100.0, 'FM999,999,990.00') as collected, to_char(v.spent_cents / 100.0, 'FM999,999,990.00') as spent, to_char(v.statement_due_by, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as statement_due_by from v_fund v join franchisor_years y on y.fy_end = v.fy_end where y.id = $1

sections.title: Spend by category
sections.sql: select s.category, count(*) as lines, to_char(sum(s.amount_cents) / 100.0, 'FM999,999,990.00') as amount from fund_spend s join franchisor_years y on fy_end_for(s.spent_on) = y.fy_end where y.id = $1 group by s.category order by sum(s.amount_cents) desc

sections.title: Contributions by site
sections.sql: select r.site_ref as site, r.site as name, r.currency, to_char(sum(r.marketing_cents) / 100.0, 'FM999,999,990.00') as levied, to_char(sum(least(r.paid_cents, r.marketing_cents)) / 100.0, 'FM999,999,990.00') as collected from v_royalties r join franchisor_years y on fy_end_for(r.period) = y.fy_end where y.id = $1 group by r.site_ref, r.site, r.currency order by r.site_ref
